item.title: Arabic–English wedding website with a real right-to-left layout
item.description: A bilingual Arabic–English wedding website where the layout truly mirrors: navigation, RSVP, timeline and gallery all run right to left in Arabic. Add the katb al-kitab and the reception as separate events, collect RSVPs in both languages in one list, and keep Arabic guest names intact. Add French as a third language if you need it.

item.title: Italian–English wedding website for a destination wedding in Italy
item.description: Getting married in Italy with guests flying in? One wedding website in Italian and English: the comune and the church ceremony as separate events with their own maps, travel and accommodation tips only in the English version, a short note on bomboniere and confetti, and clear start and end times for a long Italian reception. One RSVP list for everyone, dietary needs included.

item.title: French–English wedding website: the mairie, the vin d'honneur and the late dinner
item.description: Planning a French wedding with English-speaking guests? The civil ceremony at the mairie and the celebration are separate events, the vin d'honneur often has a wider guest list than dinner, and the evening runs far later than many guests expect. One wedding website in French and English: each event with its own time, place and description, dates in each language's format, one RSVP list.
